data.one_liner: Support for character encodings and codecs missing from dart:convert.
data.what_it_does: Provides implementation for character encodings, charsets, and codecs missing from the standard dart:convert library. Supports ISO 8859 (Latin), Windows codepages, DOS codepages, GBK, Big5, and KOI8 R/U. Allows encoding and decoding text in legacy formats.
use_when: You need to parse or generate text using legacy character encodings like ISO 8859 or Windows codepages.
You are dealing with older web pages, emails, or data streams that do not use UTF-8.
avoid_when: Your application exclusively uses modern UTF-8 or standard encodings already built into dart:convert.
strengths: Supports a wide range of legacy character sets including Latin, Windows, DOS, GBK, Big5, and KOI8.
Fully null-safe and lightweight with no external dependencies.
Provides custom codec extensibility if you need to implement your own.
weaknesses: Limited to text encoding conversions only.
